svg.title: An Error Signal alert on Discord
svg.desc: The first occurrence of a new error, marked NEW and with an @here mention: the exception message, the level, the source, the controller action, the route, the request id, the logged-in user and the process, the context the app passed, the location with its line of code, the app lines of the backtrace and the release.
